analysis_notes: mean_upwind_vmg_kn is computed from mean horizontal world velocity projected onto the true wind-from bearing; positive means progress into the wind.
runner_target_course_vmg_kn is retained separately because the P2 runner projects onto the commanded target heading, not the actual wind axis.
Failure statuses are preserved; a failed TWA result is not a valid -50 degree polar point.

p25_reference_metadata.leeway_definition: signed ground-track angle relative to bow from local vlat/vlong; NaN below 0.15 m/s
p25_reference_metadata.physics_step_note: Engine ticks/time scale are execution acceleration; each observed RigidBody physics delta is checked against the fixed simulated step.
p25_reference_metadata.stw_definition: SOG; no current system is configured and the runner sets water current to zero
p25_reference_metadata.vmg_definition: horizontal world velocity projected onto the target course direction
p25_reference_metadata.wave_definition: WaveSampler remains enabled and is queried by the boat; local sampler amplitude is set to zero for static water
